query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('documentId',d.id,'sourceId',d.id||':'||c.position,'title',d.title,'productId',d.product_id,'contentHash',d.content_hash,'revision',d.revision,'locale',c.locale,'text',c.text) AS "chunk!" FROM knowledge_documents d JOIN knowledge_chunks c ON c.tenant=d.tenant AND c.document_id=d.id WHERE d.tenant=$1 AND d.kind='guidance' AND d.visibility='private' AND NOT d.archived AND d.product_id IS NULL AND c.locale=CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(d.translations->$2->'content')='string' THEN $2 ELSE d.locale END ORDER BY d.id,c.position LIMIT 8
